briefing: NEW: your desk. Each traveller hands you a Passport. Approve only the destination open today (the Directive Memo names it), a Passport still valid (its Valid Until against the calendar) and a photo of the person at the desk.
NEW: the Entry Ticket. Ask for it: its Citizen ID must match the Passport's, and its departure date must be today.

news: Reports indicate democratic institutions are crumbling across the timeline.

briefing: NEW: the scanner and the records. Scan a paper to read it in the Investigation app, now on your PC: it must match the traveller's record (a citizen's Citizen Account; for the displaced, who now come home through your desk with a Travel Permit, the Displacement Registry).
news: BUREAU NOTICE: with Interview Protocols, desk officers may now ask travellers when they were born. Check answers against Citizen Records.

briefing: NEW: the Transponder Card and travel class. A Premium passport travels on a Premium transponder, a Standard passport on an Economy one: hold the Passport's class against the card's.
news: Art is now DOMINANT in Metapolitefsi Athens.
A renaissance of artistic movements ripples through every era.

Budget cuts close the interpreter pool. From the day after tomorrow, the displaced reach the desk speaking their own tongues, untranslated but for their key words. Order Interview Protocols today and a Speech translator tomorrow in Orders: each arrives the morning after it is ordered. Papers are still filled in English.
12,000 accounts frozen in default.
ANIMAL WELFARE: inspectors are asking after a dog called Biscuit in Block C.

briefing: NEW: the Stranding Waiver. A Standard passport on an Economy transponder also needs a signed waiver: ask for it.
news: THE ALGORITHM: al-Khwarizmi, stamped home at Desk 3, teaches the House of Wisdom 2150's arithmetic. Baghdad computes.
COLOSSAL: Ramesses II, stamped home at Desk 3, builds a temple to 2150 at Abu Simbel. It has four of him out front.
THE GENEROUS SULTAN: Saladin, stamped home at Desk 3, gives Cairo's treasury to 2150's poor. He dies with one coin.
VENI, VIDI, VICI: Julius Caesar, stamped home at Desk 3, gives Rome 2150's calendar. Nobody can find the Ides of March.
THE FUTURE IN COLOUR: Akira Kurosawa, stamped home at Desk 3, films 2150 in Tokyo. Every queue is an epic now.
Art is now DOMINANT in Showa Tokyo.
Science is now DOMINANT in Victorian Britain.
DIRECTORATE: the Debt Relief Drive begins. Every Eligible account departs this quarter.
A CROWN FOR 2150: a monarch is proclaimed on the Directorate steps. The queues are now royal queues. Traced to Desk 3: Ramesses II, day 6.
2150 IS SPLIT: The Cybernetic Age on one bank of the river, The Nuclear Age on the other. The bridge is very busy. Traced to Desk 3: Muhammad al-Khwarizmi, day 6.

desk: Martina (Merchant), turned away on day 4, tried again on day 6. Turned away twice.

briefing: NEW: Debt Relief labourers. They carry a registered Work Permit, an Economy transponder and a signed Stranding Waiver. And from today the office reads the world's language: the Bureau issues you a Translation Lens. Hover a word to read it.
news: THURSDAY NIGHT: Umm Kulthum, stamped home at Desk 3, sings Cairo a song about 2150. The streets empty to listen.
THE QUEEN COMES HOME: Cleopatra, stamped home at Desk 3, opens 2150's library in Alexandria. Rome asks for a card.
FREE MARKETS, FREE GUILDS: Oda Nobunaga, stamped home at Desk 3, opens Azuchi to 2150's trade. Every castle town booms.
ODE TO JOY: Ludwig van Beethoven, stamped home at Desk 3, writes a symphony for 2150. All men become brothers by the fourth movement.
Art is now DOMINANT in Kofun Yamato.
Art is now DOMINANT in Victorian Britain.

desk: Jonas (Merchant), turned away on day 5, tried again on day 7. Turned away twice.

briefing: NEW: dress for the destination. Look at their clothes (the wheel's Look menu): an item from another time or place causes a panic. Check it against the Costume Guide on your shelf.
news: SON OF ZEUS: Alexander the Great, stamped home at Desk 3, rules Macedon by 2150's order. One empire, one law, every city named after him.
THE ART OF WAR, VOLUME TWO: Sun Tzu, stamped home at Desk 3, writes a strategy for 2150. Every merchant in Lu buys a copy.
ORIGIN OF THE FUTURE: Charles Darwin, stamped home at Desk 3, tells London what 2150 evolved into. Gardens grow on every roof.
Science is now DOMINANT in Victorian Britain.

news: THE PRESS ROLLS: Johannes Gutenberg, stamped home at Desk 3, prints with movable metal type in Mainz. Every Rhine city reads.
95 THESES ON 2150: Martin Luther, stamped home at Desk 3, nails 2150's ideas to a church door. Every German reads them in print.
WORKERS OF ALL TIMES: Karl Marx, stamped home at Desk 3, writes a book about 2150's debts. Cologne's workers form a council.
E=MC2 FOR ALL: Albert Einstein, stamped home at Desk 3, brings 2150's physics to Berlin. Atomic kettles go on sale.

news: THINKING MACHINES: Alan Turing, stamped home at Desk 3, builds 2150's computer in Manchester. It answers back.
EVERY ACTION, AN EQUAL REACTION: Isaac Newton, stamped home at Desk 3, runs the Royal Mint on 2150's credit. London's coins never wear down.
DEBTS FORGIVEN: Hammurabi, stamped home at Desk 3, carves a law from 2150 into stone. Babylon cancels every debt.
